item.title: Version 1.0
item.changes: The first release of Editroom: a fast, free video editor for Mac Color grading with LUTs and looks, including HDR and Log footage Speed ramps, transitions and fades Auto captions, timed word by word, that follow your edit Search your footage by what's said or what's in the shot Magic: edit by asking, on this Mac or with Claude and ChatGPT Built-in MCP server, so AI apps can edit with you Export any shape, at the right loudness
